_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game's cartridge: a .j64 or .rom file (or .jag, .abs, .cof, .bin for homebrew).

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the cartridge's save memory (its EEPROM) holds at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it (jaguar.eeprom), or a RetroArch .srm. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with an empty save memory.
slots.nameHelp: a save file is identified by its extension, .eeprom, .srm or .sav.
